reason: A Cordis plugin that provides a model-facing diagnostic tool for inspecting live plugin, tool, credential metadata, approval, token, and subagent state through an extensible check registry.

summaries.zh: 通过可扩展的诊断检查注册表，为智能体提供检查插件、工具、凭据元数据、审批策略、令牌使用量和子代理状态的诊断工具。
summaries.en: Provides an extensible model-facing diagnostic tool for inspecting live plugin, tool, credential metadata, approval policy, token usage, and subagent state.

capabilities: Reads live plugin, tool, credential metadata, approval policy, token usage, and subagent state
Supports extensible diagnostic check registration by other plugins
